title: On uniqueness sets and coefficients of multiple Walsh series converging over cubes
summary: We study problems on uniqueness sets ($U$-sets) for multiple Walsh series converging over cubes and the properties of the coefficients of such series. New broad classes of $U$-sets are constructed. In particular, it is proved that hyperplanes parallel to the coordinate ones are $U$-sets. For the coefficients of multiple Walsh series converging over cubes, both the index sets on which they can be made arbitrarily large and the index sets on which these coefficients tend to zero are described.
